each smell class points

span.p:
service restored —
now find the defect

lock the fix
with a regression

never fast enough,

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
proof-test
«component» tests
Tests + actual execution evidence;
generation alone stays unverified

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
proof-review
«component» security + quality
Deliverable: a findings list;
judges, never refactors

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
proof-audit
«component» change impact
Deliverable: a backward-looking
risk memo over a diff

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
proof-debug
«component» root cause
Deliverable: minimal fix + regression;
requires a REPRODUCIBLE defect

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
proof-experiment
«component» evaluation
Deliverable: controlled comparison
with a reproducible evidence record
